newsitem.title: USA: PacBell, Winstar sign service pact.
newsitem.headline: PacBell, Winstar sign service pact.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc said on Friday Pacific Telesis Group's Pacific Bell signed an three-year contract to purchase WinStar's wireless telecommunications services whenever it needed additional network capacity, provided WinStar's prices were competitive.
Pacific Bell said they had the option to renew the contract after three years.

WinStar said it would use its 38 GHz band license and other parts of the spectrum to provide wireless services to Pacific Bell. The company said it planned to hire more engineers and support staff to meet PacBell's needs.
PacBell needed more capacity because of strong demand for T-1 and DS-3 lines and for broadband services in California, fueled by the Internet.
Specific terms of the contract were not immediately available.
